gate: new untouched external full-loop fueling validation
purpose: Record newly located public evidence and preserve the distinction between an experiment described in a publication and an eligible machine-readable holdout.

not_sufficient: raw data available only on request

candidates.title: Development, application and optimization of hydrogen refueling processes for railway vehicles
candidates.source_role: independent real refueling experiment and model-validation lead

observed.reuse_terms_for_raw_or_derived_trace: not stated on the publication page

candidates.claim_boundary: The paper supports a data request and operating-range context; its plotted example cannot close the primary full-loop holdout gate.

candidates.title: Representative Hydrogen Sampling at Hydrogen Refuelling Stations: Interplay of Sampling Strategy and Station Parameters
candidates.source_role: independent HRS dispenser/tank instrumentation and cascade-selection lead

observed.vehicle_or_sink: portable 70 MPa Type-IV tank and a 55 L sampling-device tank
observed.data_availability: raw data available from authors on request

candidates.claim_boundary: The article supports a data request and cascade/protocol context; no public raw trace is promoted to validation.

candidates.title: Hydrogen Fuel Dispensing for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles
candidates.claim_boundary: The public briefing supports face-validity ranges and a data-request lead, but its plots and aggregate endpoints cannot close the full-loop gate.

candidates.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
candidates.source_role: real station-to-vehicle data acquisition and custodian request lead

observed.reuse_terms_for_raw_or_derived_trace: not identified on public article/OSTI record

candidates.claim_boundary: This is a high-value custodian lead. The article-level channel inventory and plots cannot close the full-loop gate until raw rows, units, clock alignment, checksum and reuse permission are obtained.

candidates.title: PRESLHY Experiment series E3.1 (Cryogenic Hydrogen Blow-down/Discharge) results - part A high pressure

observed.published_component_validation: ambient direct-aperture blowdown; 22 eligible cases; 72.7% joint pass

candidates.claim_boundary: This dataset supports an independent rigid-vessel direct-aperture component check. It cannot validate dispenser, receptacle, vehicle control, ESD or a complete station-to-vehicle loop.

candidates.title: PRESLHY Experiment series 3.1, part B
candidates.source_role: independent component release and jet characterization lead
candidates.claim_boundary: A component release dataset is not evidence for vehicle filling or station controller synchronization; any use requires a separately frozen protocol and license-compliant derived outputs.

candidates.title: PRESLHY Experiment series E5.1 (Ignited Discharge) results - Benchmarking
candidates.claim_boundary: The dataset can inform release/ignition consequence checks but cannot close the synchronized station-to-vehicle gate.

candidates.title: H2-Stations Europe API v2
candidates.source_role: current public station layout and operational signal registry
candidates.claim_boundary: The API is useful for station inventory and operational-context metadata, but it does not publish a synchronized dispenser-to-vehicle measurement trace or a vehicle-tank pressure/temperature holdout.

candidates.title: NREL H2FillS hydrogen filling simulation
candidates.source_role: validated public station-to-vehicle simulator and protocol reference

observed.reuse_terms_for_raw_or_derived_trace: software license and registration; not a raw measurement archive

candidates.claim_boundary: H2FillS is useful as an independent model and protocol benchmark, but simulator output cannot serve as an external measured holdout or establish field safety.

candidates.title: ENDA HRS Connect hydrogen refuelling station monitoring
candidates.source_role: real multi-station operational monitoring data access lead

observed.reuse_terms_for_raw_or_derived_trace: not stated; access is described as client monitoring service

candidates.claim_boundary: The monitoring description confirms that real station signals exist and identifies a data-custodian lead, but no reusable public raw trace or vehicle-side channel is available from the page.

candidates.title: Hydrogen refuelling station with integrated metal hydride compressor
candidates.source_role: real station layout, operating-range and control-sequence reference
candidates.claim_boundary: The article supports station architecture, operating-range and sequence context; its figures and aggregate operation report cannot close a synchronized station-to-vehicle holdout.

outcome.next_action: Send the existing de-identified trace request package to the FCH2RAIL, ZBT and NREL data custodians; quarantine and hash any response before protocol freeze and model evaluation.
